adjudication.rationale: The diff *does* include direct tests that pin down host normalization. In `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb`, there are explicit assertions that `EmbeddableHost.new(host: 'http://example.com')` becomes `'example.com'`, that `https://...` is stripped, and that paths like `https://example.com/1234/45` are stored as `'example.com'`. So the finding’s claim that “no test asserts the stored host value” and that nothing pins down storing `'https://example.com/1234'` as `'example.com'` is contradicted by the added model spec.
